To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel method for visual explanation of deep neural networks, and that we introduce an 8-flower dataset for evaluation of methods for such explanation.

we propose a novel method for interpretation and explanation of deep neural networks that is based on automatic identification of features relevant for the classes considered by the network, without relying on annotations; we introduce a dataset for quantitative evaluation of explanation methods and show that our approach outperforms the state of the art in terms of explanation accuracy.

(i) our method can be used for both interpretation and explanation of deep neural networks; (ii) our scheme for visual explanation of deep networks is effective, and (iii) the an8Flower dataset is useful for quantitative evaluation of methods that produce visual explanations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the visual feedback capabilities of deep neural networks.
improving interpretability and explanation capabilities of DNNs, with a focus on visual feedback.
improving the interpretability of deep neural networks by providing visual explanations that are more faithful and more accurate than the existing methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is a good starting point for visual explanation, but it is not a panacea for all possible problems.
our approach provides a simple, effective and interpretable way to explain the predictions of a neural network.
our approach is the first one that is able to explain deep neural network predictions in an interpretable and objective fashion, without relying on any additional annotations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our approach provides a novel and practical method to interpret deep models and to explain their predictions, without requiring additional training data or annotations.
we propose a novel method for both interpretation and explanation of deep networks.
we propose a new scheme to interpret and explain the behavior of a deep model by identifying the features relevant to the classes of interest and visualizing them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, given a model trained on a large dataset, it is possible to identify a set of features that are relevant for the task, and use them to interpret and explain the model.
the same features that are used for interpretation of the model can be used to explain its predictions.
visual explanations of deep models are possible without relying on additional supervision.
